reviews.text:
Location & Access:
Situated just north of Devanahalli town, this spot is easy to catch on your right when driving out of Bengaluru toward Hyderabad on NH 44. Since it sits on the opposite side of the highway, you will need to take a quick U-turn right after the main traffic signal. There is plenty of dedicated parking space out front, making pulling in hassle-free.

Space & Ambience:
The property is massive. Along with a spacious air-conditioned dining hall, they also have a neat lawn area out back that looks well-suited for small gatherings or private parties. What immediately stands out is the upkeep—the entire dining area is spotless, fresh-smelling, and even the washrooms are remarkably clean, which is always a huge plus on a highway drive.

Food & Fresh Juices:
We stopped here around 9:00 AM. As is standard across most South Indian highway eateries at that hour, only the South Indian breakfast menu was available. Everything was served piping hot within 15 to 20 minutes. A special shout-out goes to their fruit juices: they are freshly squeezed with no preservatives or added sugar—something that is both rare at highway stops and genuinely commendable.

Service & Pricing:
The staff is polite, patient, and attentive when taking orders. Pricing is fair and well-aligned with the portion sizes and taste.

Verdict:
A solid, reliable highway pitstop. Between the clean washrooms, ample parking, and hot breakfast, it is well worth pulling over for if you are heading out on NH 44.

Koteshwaram – The Temple of Divine Food is a wonderful place to stop for a satisfying and delicious meal, especially if you are traveling on the highway. Located conveniently along the highway, it is easy to access and makes for a perfect break during long journeys. The moment you enter, the place feels clean, spacious, and well-organized, with a calm and welcoming atmosphere that suits families, travelers, and groups alike.
The food here is truly impressive, and the highlight of my visit was the masala dosa. It was absolutely delicious — crisp on the outside, soft inside, and cooked to perfection. The potato masala was well-spiced, flavorful, and tasted fresh. The dosa was served hot with a generous portion of chutney and sambar, both of which complemented the dosa very well. The coconut chutney was fresh and aromatic, and the sambar had a rich, authentic South Indian taste. Every bite felt satisfying and comforting.
Apart from the masala dosa, the overall menu offers a good variety of vegetarian dishes, making it suitable for breakfast, lunch, or even an early dinner stop. The quality of ingredients is clearly maintained, and the food tastes hygienic and freshly prepared. Portion sizes are good, and the pricing feels reasonable for the quality and location.
The service is quick and efficient, which is especially important for highway travelers. The staff are polite and attentive, ensuring orders are served promptly even during busy hours. The restaurant and washroom areas are clean and well-maintained, adding to the overall positive experience.
Overall, Koteshwaram – The Temple of Divine Food lives up to its name. Great taste, especially the masala dosa, convenient highway location, good service, and a clean environment make it a 5-star experience for me. I would definitely stop here again and highly recommend it to anyone traveling along this route. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Sumukh Manjunath
reviews.text:
TLDR: Discover the ultimate pit stop with endless parking, stunning gardens, and a dining experience that caters to everyone! From gourmet fine dining to quick Darshini bites, indulge in crispy dosas with perfect fillings, a delightful surprise of two bondas in soup, and creamy, fresh coffee. Enjoy friendly staff and a relaxing atmosphere that lets you unwind long after your meal. Don’t miss out on this hidden gem!

The eatery offers ample parking space, making it an ideal pit stop for travelers. It features a well-maintained front yard garden that adds to its charm. For those looking to spend quality time, there are options for fine dining, providing an elegant and comfortable atmosphere. On the other hand, for quick travelers, there is a traditional self-service Darshini type setup, perfect for grabbing a quick coffee or simply using the washroom facilities.

Speaking of washrooms, the eatery has thoughtfully categorized them into men’s, women’s, disabled, and diaper-changing rooms, ensuring convenience for all visitors. However, the only drawback is that these facilities are located at the far end of the eatery, which might be a bit inconvenient for some.

During our visit, we indulged in the benne masala dose or also more as the butter masala dosa. It was cooked to perfection, with a crispy exterior and a soft interior. The aloo filling was seasoned with just the right amount of saltiness, and the accompanying chutney and sambhar complemented the dosas beautifully, creating a harmonious blend of flavors.

We also tried the bonda soup, which was a delightful surprise. Typically, one bonda is served, but we were pleasantly surprised to receive two. While I expected it to be a bit spicier and more peppery, it was still incredibly delicious and satisfying.

To conclude our evening snack, we enjoyed a cup of coffee that was creamy and fresh, perfectly hitting the right spots and leaving us refreshed.

The staff at the eatery were exceptionally friendly and welcoming. They did not rush us to leave even after we had settled the bill, allowing us to relax and decompress on the property. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we had a great time enjoying the food and ambiance.

reviews.text:
⭐ 4.5/5 – A Divine Experience at Koteshwaram! ⭐
Visited Koteshwaram – The Temple of Divine Food recently and had a lovely experience overall! This place truly lives up to its name – divine in both food and atmosphere.
🏠 Ambience: 5/5
The vibe here is calm and welcoming. The interiors are clean and beautifully designed with a traditional-meets-modern touch. Soothing background music creates a peaceful dining environment. Great for both family outings and casual meet-ups.
🍽️ Food Quality: 4.5/5
Most of the food we ordered was absolutely delicious and full of flavour. Fresh ingredients, good portion sizes, and great presentation. Here's a quick breakdown of some dishes we tried:
Butter Naan – 5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Soft, buttery, and cooked to perfection. One of the best we’ve had!
Gobi Manchurian – 5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Crispy, tangy, and perfectly spiced. A must-try starter!
Paneer Chilli – 5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Soft paneer with a spicy kick. Balanced flavours and very satisfying.
Aloo Paratha – 2/5 ⭐⭐☆☆☆
This one could be better. The filling felt dry and a bit bland. Needs improvement in both taste and texture.
Paneer Butter Masala – 2/5 ⭐⭐☆☆☆
The gravy was too sweet and lacked richness. The paneer was good, but the overall dish was not as expected.
Still, the hits far outweighed the misses, and we're definitely looking forward to trying more from their menu!
🧼 Cleanliness: 5/5
Very clean and well-maintained space. Tables, floors, and even corners were spotless. You can tell hygiene is a top priority here.
🚗 Parking: 4.5/5
Good amount of parking space available. Well-managed area, though a little shade would be nice during hot days.
🚻 Restroom Hygiene: 5/5
Restrooms were clean, dry, and well-stocked with essentials like soap and tissues. Really appreciated this attention to detail.
✅ Overall:
Koteshwaram is a wonderful place to enjoy a peaceful and tasty meal. While a couple of dishes could use some improvement, the majority of our experience was excellent. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a clean, calm, and flavourful dining experience.
Final Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4.5/5)
Would definitely visit again – especially for that butter naan, gobi manchurian, and paneer chilli!

reviews.text:
Koteshwaram is a beautiful spot to enjoy authentic South Indian food on the outskirts of Bangalore, near Nandi Hills. The ambience is calm and refreshing, with a lovely backyard that has jamun and mango trees, adding to the charm.

The food is excellent — we tried **rava masala dosa, button idli, puri sagu, and filter coffee**, all of which were delicious. The place is also very thoughtfully designed with **wheelchair access, a restroom for the differently-abled, and even a baby room**, making it convenient for all kinds of visitors.

A perfect place to stop by for great food and a peaceful atmosphere while heading towards Nandi Hills. 🌿☕🥭

They have ample parking space and the restaurant is disabled friendly.
